title: Has anyone dreamt of a weird apartment building?
content: I remember two separate dreams where I am in an apartment building. One is dark, and the other is set in the afternoon. The first dream is in a dark apartment building where every floor has a carnivorous, dog-sized monster that hunts anyone who leaves their apartment at night. The second dream is in a tall apartment building with seemingly infinite floors and no proper exit. There is only one unit per floor. The building is wide, but the way to move from one floor to another is very narrow, like the entrance to the Paris underground catacombs. I remember being stuck on the 98th floor with a poor family. I don’t know if this is related, but there is also a dream that takes place outside of buildings. I am on a street where people have gathered because a comet is about to hit the Earth. It is a hagstone comet. People embrace the event as if they are celebrating. When it hits, the ground collapses, revealing multiple underground layers that also collapse. It looks like a parking lot
